text:
acme-ci: hitting reproducible failures where streaming tool-call args end up as partial JSON after a resume/keepalive. We get a schema validation error on the tool layer (400). Request id rz-8a9f, route /v1/invoke/tool, region us-east-1. Any ideas?

maria_support: sorry about that — can you paste the request id + a small chunk capture (the raw SSE events) and confirm whether you're behind a proxy/edge gateway?

acme-ci: pasted raw SSE snippet below (we see keepalives injected by our gateway):

```
data: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"charge","args":"{\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"meta\":{\"order_id\":\"ord_123\""}
data: :keepalive

# next chunk after ~12s
data: {"type":"keepalive"}
```

After assembly the server-side JSON ends up missing closing braces: trailing string looks like `..., \"order_id\":\"ord_123\"` (no `}}`). Parser returns "Invalid JSON, expected EOF" and the runtime emits schema validation fail for the tool args.

kevin_runtime: thanks — that pattern matches a chunked-transfer + keepalive interleave where the gateway splits an event in the middle and inserts a keepalive event between chunks. Our SSE reassembly used to assume a single event per JSON object; we tolerate multi-chunk but not when unrelated keepalive events interrupt in-flight JSON. Hypothesis: the upstream LB is splitting at MTU/4k boundary and our keepalive is inserted as its own event, causing the decoder to flush incomplete buffer.

acme-ci: we rolled a gateway change on Tue; we can revert or change keepalive cadence. Is there a recommended mitigation we can apply client-side quickly?

sarah_sre: short mitigation: increase keepalive interval on the gateway to >= 30s (so it won't hit during typical chunk sends). Also capture a tcpdump and SSE event logs for request id rz-8a9f and send to eng.

maria_support: escalating to eng-runtime. @kevin_runtime please triage, customer impact: several user flows failing intermittently (P1 for the customer). Also customer asked about billing credits if failures continue.

kevin_runtime: taking this. Repro steps I'm using locally: run curl -N --header "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" and feed two separate chunks where the first chunk contains the first half of the JSON args and then emit a "data: :keepalive" event before sending the remainder. That reproduces the parser throwing a schema error. Patch idea: buffer event fragments across unrelated keepalive events until the event stream forms a valid JSON object or we hit a size/timeout; then parse. I'll validate and push a canary fix.

acme-ci: can you share a recommended temporary config? we'll change the gateway keepalive immediately if that buys time.

kevin_runtime: temporary suggestion: set gateway keepalive to 60s and enable "prefer-complete-event" reassembly on the gateway if supported. We'll push a canary with improved reassembly within the hour.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: sse-reassembler v0.12.8 -> r-infer-canary (sha: 7b4e2a).

kevin_runtime: canary rolled. Added metric runtime.sse.partial_args.count and alert if >0.1% of requests. Follow-ups: add unit tests for keepalive interleaving and add a graceful buffer with size/timeouts to avoid unbounded memory.

maria_support: customer to test now with increased keepalive and report back. Keeping thread open. Will log refund request pending results. :+1:
